radius.note: Radius values in code must match this scale — use the --radius-* tokens. 0 and 1 are allowed for hairlines.

rules: Components must not embed raw hex; use var(--color-*) or var(--cta-*) tokens.
CTAs must render their label via .aurora-cta utility (text-transform:uppercase baked in) — no <button class="bg-curefit-yellow">.
CTAs placed side-by-side must be wrapped in .aurora-cta-twins (equal-width, 50px row). Mixing a standalone 50px Primary with a standalone 40px Secondary is not allowed.
The DS repo ships tokens + primitives only. No feature-screen components (game UIs, specific pages, marketing illustrations) — those belong to the product app consuming the DS.
No spacing off the 5px rhythm. No px radius outside the radius scale.
Fonts limited to allowed_fonts; forbidden_fonts must not appear in imports, fontFamily, or className.
No handwritten script fonts anywhere — Aurora is Inter-forward.
No cream / beige / parchment card surfaces. Cards are rgba(255,255,255,0.10) dark or rgba(255,255,255,0.60) white.
No purple / lavender text or accents. Aurora accents are yellow / pink / blue / green / coral / gold only.
Display type on a card must use tokens from --text-h*. No raw fontSize > 32px with inline fontFamily.
Every pixel decision traces to a Figma source (app or web).

purple handwritten accent labels (hex family around #7F5BFF)
